dimensions.assessment: Directly affects federal administrative agencies, the State of Arkansas, and academic entities such as the University of Arkansas.
dimensions.evidence: To require the Secretary of Agriculture to convey the Crossett Experimental Forest to the State of Arkansas, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Transfers ownership and management responsibility of a specific research forest property from the federal government to the state.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary shall convey to the State all right, title, and interest of the United States in and to the Forest.

dimensions.assessment: Conveyance is made without consideration, and all administrative and survey costs are to be paid by the State of Arkansas.
dimensions.evidence: Any costs relating to the conveyance under subsection (b), including costs for surveys and other administrative costs, shall be paid by the State.

dimensions.assessment: Applies strictly to a single designated property and its specified administrative provisions.
dimensions.evidence: To require the Secretary of Agriculture to convey the Crossett Experimental Forest to the State of Arkansas, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent transfer of land ownership, subject to potential reversion to the United States if management terms are violated.
dimensions.evidence: all right, title, and interest in and to the Forest, or the portion of the Forest affected by the failure, may, at the discretion of the Secretary, revert to the United States.

missing_information: Exact acreage and monetary valuation of the Crossett Experimental Forest
importance_detail.rationale: This bill mandates the conveyance of a specific federal experimental forest and associated facilities in Arkansas to the State without consideration, subject to certain management conditions and reversionary interests.
